title: TC-ADP-02-05: adp02_tenant_scope_test.zig has the same audit_entries.resource_id = $1::uuid vs TEXT column mismatch as ISS-0637 (C42883)
symptom: TC-ADP-02-05 ("audit persistence is tenant-scoped for audit_entries and audit_log") fails with PgError.ServerError. Standalone reproduction with -Dlog-pg-errors=true shows: POSTGRES ERROR: C42883 operator does not exist: text = uuid, at tests/integration/adp02_tenant_scope_test.zig:530 (conn.query with `resource_id = $1::uuid AND tenant_id = $2::uuid`, and the mirrored query at line 549).
root_cause: Same root cause as ISS-0637 (GH-619): migration GBL-120_iss103_audit_resource_id_text.sql (ISS-103) changed audit_entries.resource_id from UUID to TEXT in every schema. This test still casts the parameter to ::uuid when comparing against resource_id, which PostgreSQL rejects (no implicit text/uuid cast) with C42883. Discovered incidentally while confirming ISS-0637's fix pattern was correctly scoped and checking for the same bug class elsewhere in the test suite (grep for `resource_id = $1::uuid` across tests/integration/).
resolution: tests/integration/adp02_tenant_scope_test.zig: removed the `::uuid` cast on both `resource_id = $1` comparisons (lines 532, 549), matching the TEXT column type audit_entries.resource_id has carried since GBL-120. The mirrored audit_log.entity_id comparisons on the same lines were left untouched — confirmed via migrations/009_audit_log.sql that audit_log.entity_id is genuinely UUID-typed and unaffected by GBL-120 (which only touches audit_entries.resource_id). Verified via new `zig build test-integration-adp02` narrow target: 4/5 tests pass; the remaining failure (TC-ADP-02-01, `expected 6, found 0`) is the pre-existing, separately-tracked provisioning-gap issue GH-482/ISS-0150, unrelated to this fix.
acceptance_criteria: resource_id comparisons in adp02_tenant_scope_test.zig match the TEXT column type (no ::uuid cast on resource_id)
notes: Also observed independently in the same standalone run: TC-ADP-02-01 ("migration provisions tenant columns, tenant indexes, and tenant policies") fails with `expected 6, found 0` — a different, unrelated symptom, consistent with the broader pre-existing test-integration-svc provisioning-gap failures already tracked under GitHub #482 / ISS-0150 (34 affected files including adp02_tenant_scope_test and ext02_webhook_dispatch_test, dominant symptom `relation tenant_<uuid>.schema_migrations does not exist`). TC-ADP-02-01's failure was not separately diagnosed here — likely covered by #482's existing scope; not re-filed. This ISS-0638 is scoped narrowly to the C42883 resource_id type-mismatch pattern only, which is a distinct, independently-actionable root cause from #482's provisioning-gap symptom. Not fixed on the GH-619/ISS-0637 branch — filed and forwarded to the global queue per the one-issue-one-run rule.
